rnaseq_from_fastq: To obtain gene expression counts from bulk RNA-seq data. Input: paired-end FASTQ files from bulk RNA-seq Output: count matrix and QC report Method: alignment and quantification (STAR+Salmon)
de_from_count_matrix: Identify differentially expressed genes between two conditions using RNA-seq data. Input: count matrix from RNA-seq Output: differentially expressed genes list with associated statistics Method: differential expression analysis (DESeq2 or edgeR)
scrna_from_fastq: To generate a cell-by-gene count matrix from single-cell RNA-seq data. Input: 10X Genomics single-cell RNA-seq FASTQ files Output: cell-by-gene count matrix Method: alignment and quantification (Cell Ranger)
methylation_wgbs: Analyze CpG methylation from bisulfite-converted whole genome sequencing reads. Input: bisulfite-converted FASTQ files from whole genome sequencing Output: methylation calls and methylation frequency report Method: bisulfite alignment (Bismark)
methylation_array: Identify differentially methylated regions from methylation array data. Input: Illumina EPIC array IDAT files Output: differentially methylated regions Method: methylation analysis (minfi or ChAMP)
bam_to_fastq: Convert aligned BAM file back to FASTQ format for re-alignment with a different reference. Input: aligned BAM file Output: FASTQ files Method: BAM to FASTQ conversion (samtools)
bcl_demux: Convert raw BCL files into FASTQ format for downstream analysis. Input: raw BCL flowcell directory Output: FASTQ files for each sample Method: demultiplexing and conversion (bcl2fastq)
atacseq_no_antibody: Identify open chromatin regions using ATAC-seq. Input: paired-end FASTQ from ATAC-seq Output: peaks in BED format and QC report Method: ATAC-seq peak calling (MACS2)
chipseq_antibody: Identify peaks of H3K27ac enrichment in the ChIP-seq data. Input: single-end FASTQ files from ChIP-seq Output: peaks in BED format and peak calling report Method: ChIP-seq peak calling (MACS2)
cutandrun_antibody: Identify peaks associated with H3K4me3 modifications in CUT&RUN data. Input: paired-end FASTQ files from CUT&RUN sequencing Output: peak calls in BED format and associated QC report Method: CUT&RUN peak calling (MACS2)
hic_conformation: Identify topologically associating domains (TADs) and generate contact maps from Hi-C data. Input: Hi-C raw read pairs in FASTQ format Output: TAD boundaries and contact maps Method: Hi-C data processing and TAD calling (Juicebox or HiC-Pro)
somatic_variant_tumor_normal: Identify somatic mutations in tumor samples compared to matched normal samples. Input: paired-end FASTQ from whole genome sequencing of matched tumor and normal samples Output: variant call format (VCF) file with somatic mutations Method: variant calling (GATK Mutect2)
tcr_bcr_repertoire: To analyze T-cell receptor and B-cell receptor repertoires from VDJ sequencing data. Input: paired-end FASTQ files from VDJ sequencing Output: TCR and BCR repertoire analysis report with clonotype diversity metrics Method: repertoire analysis (MiXCR or IgBlast)
amplicon_16s: Characterize gut microbiome composition and diversity using 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing data. Input: paired-end FASTQ files from 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing Output: OTU table and alpha/beta diversity metrics Method: 16S rRNA sequence processing and diversity analysis (QIIME2)
shotgun_metagenomics_taxa: Identify the species present in a metagenomic sample. Input: shotgun metagenomic FASTQ files Output: taxonomic profile of species present Method: taxonomic classification (Kraken2 or MetaPhlAn)
metagenome_assembly: Assemble metagenomic reads into contigs, bin them into metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs), and assess their completeness. Input: paired-end FASTQ files from metagenomic sequencing Output: contig sequences, MAGs, and completeness assessment report Method: metagenomic assembly (SPAdes) and binning (MaxBin or MetaBAT)
crispr_screen: Analyze editing efficiency and identify on-target indels from a CRISPR knockout screen. Input: paired-end FASTQ from CRISPR knockout screen sequencing Output: editing efficiency metrics and on-target indel calls Method: variant calling and analysis (CRISPResso2)
ancient_dna: Mapping degraded ancient DNA sequences while accounting for DNA damage patterns. Input: degraded short reads in FASTQ format Output: aligned BAM file with DNA damage patterns annotated Method: ancient DNA alignment (mapDamage + BWA)
bacterial_assembly: Assemble a bacterial genome and annotate its genes. Input: paired-end FASTQ from Illumina sequencing Output: assembled genome in FASTA format and gene annotation in GFF format Method: genome assembly (SPAdes) and gene annotation (Prokka)
paraphrase_scrna_10x: Analyze single-cell RNA-seq data from 10X Genomics. Input: 10X Genomics single-cell FASTQ files Output: gene expression matrix and clustering results Method: single-cell RNA-seq analysis (Cell Ranger)
paraphrase_de_genes: Identify differentially expressed genes between treatment and control groups. Input: paired-end FASTQ from bulk RNA-seq Output: differential expression results including log2 fold changes and p-values Method: differential expression analysis (DESeq2 or edgeR)
paraphrase_wgbs: Determine CpG methylation levels across the genome from whole genome bisulfite sequencing data. Input: raw BCL flowcell directory Output: methylation calls and methylation level reports Method: bisulfite alignment (Bismark)
paraphrase_ncrna: Quantification of all transcripts including non-coding RNAs from total RNA-seq data. Input: processed FASTQ files from total RNA-seq Output: count matrix and QC report Method: alignment and quantification (STAR+Salmon)
paraphrase_immune_repertoire: Identify the dominant antibody clones in B-cell sequencing data. Input: paired-end FASTQ from B-cell receptor sequencing Output: clonotype abundance table and diversity metrics Method: clonotype analysis (MiXCR or IgBlast)
paraphrase_gut_microbiome: Characterize the microbial community composition in stool samples. Input: 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing data (e.g. FASTQ files) Output: OTU table and taxonomic classification report Method: 16S rRNA gene sequencing analysis (QIIME2 or DADA2)
multihop_open_chromatin: Identify accessible genomic regions to determine active regulatory elements in a specific cell type. Input: ATAC-seq paired-end FASTQ files Output: peaks of accessible chromatin regions and associated annotation Method: ATAC-seq peak calling (MACS2)
multihop_cell_type_annotation: Identify the cell types present in a tumor biopsy at single-cell resolution. Input: 10X Genomics single-cell RNA-seq data (filtered gene-barcode matrix) Output: cell type annotation and expression profiles Method: single-cell RNA-seq analysis (Seurat or Scanpy)
multihop_de_genes_from_fastq: Identify differentially expressed genes between treated and untreated cells. Input: paired-end FASTQ files from RNA-seq Output: count matrix and differential expression results Method: alignment and quantification (STAR+DESeq2)
multihop_protein_binding_site: Identify the binding sites of a transcription factor in the genome. Input: ChIP-seq FASTQ files Output: peak calls in BED format and associated QC report Method: ChIP-seq peak calling (MACS2)
multihop_microbiome_diversity: Compare alpha and beta diversity metrics between two patient cohorts in a gut microbiome study. Input: 16S rRNA gene sequencing data in FASTQ format from two patient cohorts Output: alpha and beta diversity metrics, including visualizations such as PCoA plots Method: diversity analysis (QIIME2 or phyloseq)
multihop_chromatin_looping: Identify chromatin loops and topologically associated domains (TADs) from proximity ligation data. Input: Hi-C contact matrix or raw Hi-C sequencing data (e.g. paired-end FASTQ files) Output: chromatin loop and TAD annotations Method: Hi-C data analysis (Juicebox or HiC-Pro)
log_diann_to_rnaseq: Identify and quantify proteins from mass spectrometry data. Input: raw Thermo .raw files Output: protein quantification results and identification report Method: label-free quantification (DIA-NN)
log_diann_paraphrase: Quantification of proteins from data-independent acquisition mass spectrometry data. Input: data-independent acquisition mass spectrometry raw files (e.g. .raw, .mzML) Output: protein abundance matrix and QC report Method: protein quantification (MaxQuant or DIA-NN)
log_bulk_rnaseq_de_vs_rnaseq: To generate a count matrix from RNA-seq data. Input: paired-end FASTQ files Output: count matrix and QC report Method: alignment and quantification (STAR+Salmon)
log_pksim_vs_pbpk_native: To simulate the pharmacokinetics of a small molecule compound using PBPK modeling. Input: compound structure file (e.g. SDF or SMILES format) Output: PK-Sim simulation results including concentration-time profiles and tissue distribution data Method: physiologically-based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) modeling
log_epitopeprediction_vs_mhcquant: Identify potential MHC class I epitopes from a given protein sequence. Input: protein sequence in FASTA format Output: predicted MHC class I epitopes with binding affinities Method: epitope prediction (NetMHCpan)
log_mhcquant_lc_ms: Identify HLA-presented peptides from immunopeptidomics data. Input: LC-MS/MS raw data files (e.g. .raw or .mzML) Output: list of identified HLA-presented peptides Method: peptide identification and quantification (MaxQuant or similar)
semantic_scrna_de: To identify differentially expressed genes between conditions in single-cell RNA-seq data. Input: annotated h5ad file with cell type labels Output: differential expression results including log fold changes and p-values Method: differential expression analysis (Scanpy or Seurat)
semantic_wgbs_vs_array: Identify differentially methylated regions (DMRs) between case and control samples. Input: Bismark methylation extraction output files (e.g. .txt or .csv files with methylation calls) Output: differentially methylated regions (DMRs) report Method: DMR analysis (e.g. DSS or methylKit)
semantic_somatic_cnv: Detect copy number alterations and structural variants in cancer genomes. Input: raw BCL flowcell directory from whole-genome sequencing Output: copy number variation (CNV) calls and structural variant (SV) calls Method: variant calling and CNV analysis (GATK+CNVkit)
semantic_mag_binning: Reconstruct individual microbial genomes from a complex environmental sample. Input: raw BCL flowcell directory Output: assembled genomes in FASTA format Method: metagenomic assembly (SPAdes or MEGAHIT)
